diagnosis.root_cause: External pose reset at 21.5 s set the robot's estimated position to (-4.78, -3.4), causing a significant drift from reality (confirmed by a 2.66 m jump at 21.7 s). This unreliable localization led to repeated planning failures and eventual mission failure when obstacles appeared near PICK_B.
evidence: External pose reset (/initialpose) set estimate to (-4.78, -3.4) at 21.5 s
Pose estimate jumped 2.66 m and 0.54 rad at 21.7 s
Planner failed to find a path 21 times
Obstacles appeared near PICK_B from 151.7 s to 180.7 s, preventing route completion
